tasks.description_html:
# Secret Rotation Checklist

# Compromised during Infisical migration on 2026-07-29

# DO NOT paste new values into chat. Use this checklist locally.

# =============================================================================

# HOW TO USE THIS FILE

# =============================================================================

# 1. Open the URL listed next to each secret

# 2. Generate a new value (revoke the old one first if required)

# 3. Run the infisical secrets set command for each environment

# 4. Check off or delete the line when done

# 5. When finished, restart the agent:

#    launchctl stop com.infisical.agent && launchctl start com.infisical.agent

# =============================================================================

# 1. DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN (Assistedly Discord Bot)

#    Generate: https://discord.com/developers/applications

#    Nav: Select "Assistedly" app → Bot → Reset Token → Copy

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/assistedly-discord-bot && infisical secrets set DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 2. DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL (Firecrawl Grants / Server Ops)

#    Generate: https://discord.com/channels/@me → Select channel → Settings →

#              Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy URL

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/firecrawl-grants && infisical secrets set DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

# =============================================================================

# 3. OPENAI_API_KEY

#    Generate: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

#    Nav: Find old key → Revoke → Create new secret key → Copy

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/assistedly-discord-bot && infisical secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 4. CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN

#    Generate: https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens

#    Nav: Find "Assistedly" token → Roll → Copy

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 5. CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY (Global API Key)

#    Generate: https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens

#    Nav: API Keys → Global API Key → Change → Copy

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 6. DIFY_API_KEY (Public API Key)

#    Generate: https://dify.forwardjump.com/app-settings/api-keys

#    Nav: Overview → API Keys → Regenerate → Copy

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DIFY_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DIFY_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DIFY_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 7. DIFY_API_BASE_URL (If exposed — check if it contains secrets)

#    This is a URL, not a secret. Only rotate if it contained a token.

#    Otherwise verify it's still correct:

#    https://dify.forwardjump.com/v1

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# (No action needed unless it contained an embedded key)

# =============================================================================

# 8. RESEND_API_KEY

#    Generate: https://resend.com/api-keys

#    Nav: Revoke old key → Create API Key → Copy

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set RESEND_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set RESEND_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set RESEND_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 9. AUTH_MAGIC_LINK_SECRET

#    Generate: Use openssl rand -base64 64 or node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Generate locally on your Mac:

# node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set AUTH_MAGIC_LINK_SECRET="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set AUTH_MAGIC_LINK_SECRET="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set AUTH_MAGIC_LINK_SECRET="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 10. POSTHOG_KEY (Project API Key)

#    Generate: https://us.posthog.com/project/settings

#    Nav: Project API Key → Regenerate → Copy

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set POSTHOG_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set POSTHOG_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set POSTHOG_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 11. POSTHOG_HOST

#    This is usually a non-secret URL (e.g. https://us.i.posthog.com).

#    Only rotate if it contained an embedded key.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# (No action needed unless it contained an embedded key)

# =============================================================================

# 12. DATAFORSEO_USERNAME

#    Generate: https://app.dataforseo.com/profile

#    Nav: API Access → Reset Login → Copy

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DATAFORSEO_USERNAME="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DATAFORSEO_USERNAME="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DATAFORSEO_USERNAME="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 13. DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD

#    Generate: Same page as above → Reset Password → Copy

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 14. PLANE_API_KEY

#    Generate: https://app.plane.so

#    Nav: Workspace Settings → API Tokens → Revoke → Create New → Copy

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set PLANE_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set PLANE_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set PLANE_API_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 15. GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON

#    Generate: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/serviceaccounts

#    Nav: Select service account → Keys → Add Key → Create new key (JSON) → Download

#    WARNING: Download creates a new file. Upload the contents to Infisical.

#    To get the JSON contents as a single string for Infisical:

#    cat ~/Downloads/new-service-account.json | jq -c | pbcopy

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# Also update firecrawl-grants if it uses a different account:

cd ~/firecrawl-grants && infisical secrets set GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

# =============================================================================

# 16. DATABASE_MCP_URL (PostgreSQL connection string)

#    Generate: Database provider dashboard (e.g. Supabase, Railway, AWS RDS)

#    Nav: Connection settings → Reset password → New connection string

#    Common: Supabase → https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/settings/database

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Replace <provider> with your actual database provider URL

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DATABASE_MCP_URL="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DATABASE_MCP_URL="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set DATABASE_MCP_URL="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 17. ZABBIX_MCP_URL

#    Generate: Your Zabbix server admin panel

#    Nav: Administration → Users → API → Regenerate key

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set ZABBIX_MCP_URL="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set ZABBIX_MCP_URL="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set ZABBIX_MCP_URL="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 18. DIFY_MCP_URL

#    Generate: Same as DIFY_API_BASE_URL if this contains a token.

#    If it's just the base URL, skip.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# (No action needed unless it contained an embedded key)

# =============================================================================

# 19. SSH_DEPLOY_KEY (for server deployment)

#    Generate: On your Mac terminal

#    ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/assistedly_deploy_new -N ""

#    Then add the PUBLIC key to server's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys

#    Update the private key in Infisical:

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# cat ~/.ssh/assistedly_deploy_new | pbcopy

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set SSH_DEPLOY_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set SSH_DEPLOY_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set SSH_DEPLOY_KEY="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# 20. CLOUDFLARED_CERT_PEM (Cloudflare tunnel certificate)

#    Generate: On the server where cloudflared is installed

#    ssh opencode@75.127.14.185 "cloudflared tunnel token assistedly"  # or re-authenticate

#    Or: cloudflared tunnel login

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# This is stored as a PEM block. After regenerating, copy the new cert content:

# ssh opencode@75.127.14.185 "cat ~/.cloudflared/cert.pem" | pbcopy

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set CLOUDFLARED_CERT_PEM="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env dev --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set CLOUDFLARED_CERT_PEM="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env staging --path /

cd ~/Assistedly.ai && infisical secrets set CLOUDFLARED_CERT_PEM="PASTE_NEW_VALUE_HERE" --env prod --path /

# =============================================================================

# DONE? Restart the agent to pick up all changes immediately

# =============================================================================

# launchctl stop com.infisical.agent && launchctl start com.infisical.agent

# =============================================================================

# SECURITY REMINDERS

# =============================================================================

# - DELETE THIS FILE after completing all rotations

# - NEVER commit this file to git

# - NEVER paste new values into Goose chat

# - shred -u ~/SECRET-ROTATION-CHECKLIST.md when done
